verdict.rationale: The gaming axis applies to a chip with an integrated GPU. However, the evidence pack contains no vendor gaming claims about cache, boost or iGPU class, and no independent game benchmarks or frame-rate data. The cTDP and Curve Optimizer spec lines are adjacent tuning controls, not evidence of in-game performance. Community comments only note that existing benchmarks lacked GPU or real-world comparisons.

support.subject: As a gamer, this chip drives high frame rates in real games — vendor gaming claims (cache, boost behavior, integrated GPU class) corroborated by independent game benchmarks
